scope: LiDAR perception/tracking inference inputs (Main: SensorPoseHistory -> PrepareScan -> LidarProcess). Evaluation-only data is listed separately and must never reach inference.
sources_of_rules: user instruction 2026-10-22 (allowed: vel_x, provided attitude and angular rate, separate GPS; forbidden: Competition Vehicle Status pos_x/y/z, vel_y, vel_z, accel_x/y/z, tyre lateral force, slip angle and other unprovided fields)
2026-ASMC-nogps docs/competition/README.md:70-71,86-91 (GPS max 30 Hz and IMU max 50 Hz allowed; Ego Vehicle Status / Ego Detail Status are judging-only)
2026-ASMC-nogps config/morai/README.md:57-73 (Competition Vehicle Status = MolitComp03 type 787, UDP 9797->9798; observed packet #DetailEgoInfo$ 105 B is not decoded by the current bridge)

allowed_inference_inputs.source_competition: Competition Vehicle Status (UDP 9798, MolitComp03 type 787) -> asmc_bridge morai_udp_bridge -> /Competition_topic morai_msgs/EgoVehicleStatus.velocity.x
allowed_inference_inputs.timestamp: header.stamp; bridge receive time by default (morai_udp_bridge.launch timestamp_mode)
allowed_inference_inputs.consumer: SensorPoseHistory::AddCan -> local lookup (IMU+CAN required) -> FrameBoundary ego_linear_base, Tracking absolute velocity, MotionClassifier, ego_translation_comp option
allowed_inference_inputs.missing_handling: no sample within lidar_pose_can_max_age_s (0.12 s) -> LiDAR scan not ready (skipped, reason recorded); negative value rejected by AddCan (P0 behaviour, documented as a finding)
allowed_inference_inputs.status_in_product_P0: VIOLATION: Parser.cpp:532-533 uses sqrt(vx^2+vy^2+vz^2) and main.launch:126-128 remaps /Competition_topic to the judging-only /Ego_topic
allowed_inference_inputs.status_in_stage1_harness: competition mode reads only column vel_x_mps
allowed_inference_inputs.dataset_availability: NOT RECORDED in Lidar_Data / dataset (ego_pose has pose only). Emulated: central difference of evaluation positions projected on the evaluation heading (vel_y excluded), stamped at t_lidar (age 0). Label: VEL_X_EMULATED_FROM_EVAL_POSE

allowed_inference_inputs.consumer: leveling (roll/pitch), tracking yaw alignment, map rotation
allowed_inference_inputs.missing_handling: no IMU within lidar_pose_imu_max_age_s (0.12 s) -> scan skipped; |q|^2-1 > 0.001 -> invalid
allowed_inference_inputs.dataset_availability: NOT RECORDED. yaw emulated from the evaluation heading (bag evidence: IMU yaw - Ego heading p95 0.2-0.8 deg). roll/pitch NOT AVAILABLE -> NaN in frames_comp.csv; the harness then levels with roll=pitch=0 and writes rp_available=0 per scan (flat-ground assumption, leveling path not validated). Label: IMU_YAW_EMULATED_FROM_EVAL_HEADING

allowed_inference_inputs.consumer: none in P0 or stage-1 code (yaw change is taken from consecutive orientation samples)

allowed_inference_inputs.source_competition: /imu sensor_msgs/Imu.linear_acceleration (allowed sensor, distinct from the forbidden Vehicle Status accel)
GPS sensor (NMEA GGA) -> morai_sensor_bridge -> /gps morai_msgs/GPSMessage, ~5 Hz measured (setting.yaml says 30)
allowed_inference_inputs.unit: deg / m, UTM52N minus map offsets
allowed_inference_inputs.consumer: map pose (MapAt), /lidar/map_object, MotionClassifier map history, legacy /last_lidar and UDP
allowed_inference_inputs.missing_handling: map pose invalid when GPS older than 0.30 s or invalid -> local output continues, map output and motion_state stop
allowed_inference_inputs.dataset_availability: NOT RECORDED. Competition-mode runs feed NO GPS (the evaluation pose is never presented as GPS). Map-dependent outputs (motion_state, planner path values) are therefore not evaluable on this data

forbidden_inference_inputs.stage1_competition_mode: never read (column present only for the isolation test)

forbidden_inference_inputs.status_P0_harness: used as IMU yaw (equivalent value, judging-only source)
forbidden_inference_inputs.stage1_competition_mode: the IMU yaw channel is emulated from it and labelled; no other use

forbidden_inference_inputs.field: tyre lateral force, side slip, cornering stiffness, wheel_angle

evaluation_only: Lidar_Data labels_3d_lidar_v1 object GT (gt.csv): matching, metrics, offline trace-to-GT linking only

evaluation ego pose (frames.csv ego_x/y/z/yaw): evaluator map-aligned temporal differencing, ego-motion categories of the supplementary metrics, emulation of the allowed vel_x / IMU yaw channels (labelled)
never used for matching, observation selection, filtering, classification, online parameter tuning or the published output

harness_contract.reader: ReadCompetitionFrames(): looks up columns ONLY by the names idx, stem, stamp_ns, npy, vel_x_mps, imu_yaw_rad, imu_roll_rad (optional), imu_pitch_rad (optional)
harness_contract.feed_per_scan: AddImu(stamp=t_lidar, q from roll/pitch/yaw; roll=pitch=0 when NaN), AddCan(stamp=t_lidar, vel_x); no AddGps
harness_contract.per_scan_record: jsonl field ego_in {vel_x, imu_yaw, rp_available, gps:0}
